messages:
keera: dropping a quick thread on a keyboard-first onboarding flow prototype. idea: make the first-run checklist fully operable without a mouse (tab order, visible focus, keyboard shortcuts for mark-done / next). want quick UX, a11y, and telemetry feedback.

matt: love it. keyboard users get shortchanged now. question: do we expose keyboard shortcuts in a help tooltip or inline in each step?

marta: telemetry-wise expose vs hidden will affect learnability. suggest an inline hint on first two visits: 'Tip: press K to toggle checklist'. fire onboarding.shortcut.impression only once per user.

oliver: accessibility checklist: 1) ensure logical tab order; 2) visible 4px focus ring that meets contrast; 3) announce state changes with polite aria-live messages for step completion; 4) provide a skip link to main canvas at the start of the tab order. avoid forcing focus unless user triggers the shortcut.

tara: microcopy: primary CTA text should be short: 'Mark done' for steps, and for global CTA use 'Finish setup'. show shortcut hint as small subdued text: 'Press K to open checklist'.

matt: engineering Q: global shortcut conflicts with browser or editor shortcuts. recommend modifier: Shift+K or ? to open the full help overlay. we can surface a keyboard help modal with a list of shortcuts.

keera: good call. use '?' to open help modal and Shift+K to toggle checklist. add an onboarding.shortcuts.help event when modal opened.

oliver: a11y nit: ensure shortcut hints are programmatically hidden from AT users unless they focus the element (use aria-hidden on decorative hints). for announceable events (step complete) use aria-live="polite" region with succinct text like 'Step 2 completed'.

marta: experiment variants: control (current onboarding), variant A (keyboard-first default enabled), variant B (keyboard-first + visible shortcut hints). primary metric = time-to-first-successful-run; secondary = checklist completion rate and shortcut usage. keys: onboarding.kbview, onboarding.kbtoggle, onboarding.kbhelp, onboarding.step.complete.

matt: performance note: avoid heavy JS for shortcut handling on low-end devices; use a small event listener and ensure cleanup on unmount. also guard for input fields to avoid capturing keystrokes while typing.

keera: snippet for shortcut handler we'll use in proto:

```js
// small, focus-friendly handler
window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if ((e.shiftKey && e.key === 'K') && document.activeElement.tagName !== 'INPUT') {
    e.preventDefault();
    toggleChecklist();
  }
});
```

oliver: for focus flow: when Shift+K opens checklist, move focus to first checkbox but don't trap unless user tabs into panel. Esc should close and return focus to the element that opened it. include visible 'Close' as first control.

marta: telemetry detail: only fire onboarding.kbtoggle when user actually toggles, not on impression. record previous state to support retention rate analysis.

keera: UX question: do we show progress percentage in the keyboard UI or just step index (e.g., '2 of 4')?

matt: '2 of 4' is concise and reads better for screen readers. percent can be visual but avoid announcing it repeatedly.

keera: action items: matt - prototype keyboard handler + help modal; oliver - draft final a11y checklist and focus ring token; marta - add telemetry keys and experiment config; tara - microcopy variants and hint wording. i'll schedule 15m sync Tue 11am to review prototype.

deploy-bot: reminder: onboarding design freeze is Friday 5pm PT. link final comps to the RELEASE ticket.

matt: i'll upload the proto by Mon EOD and tag oliver for a11y sign-off. :thumbsup:

keera: thanks team d leaving thread open for any last keyboard or focus concerns.
